shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la reports/audit 2>&1; ls demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references 2>&1 | head -50
find demo/acme-corp/evidence -type f | sort && wc -c demo/acme-corp/evidence/*/* demo/acme-corp/evidence/*.md | tail -1

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && grep -inE 'version|effective|review|owner|approved|last updated|next' policies/*.md | cut -c1-200; echo ---; grep -ohE '"[a-zA-Z_]*(date|time|timestamp|generated|updated|as_of|period)[a-zA-Z_]*": *"[^"]*"' reports/*.json | sort | uniq -c | head -60; echo ---

for f in policies/*.md; do echo "== $f"; head -6 "$f" | cut -c1-160; done; echo; for f in reports/okta_mfa_report.json reports/jamf_mdm_compliance.json reports/knowbe4_training_report.json reports/aws_security_hub.json; do echo "== $f"; head -c 900 "$f"; echo; done

head -n 6 policies/access_control_policy.md policies/business_continuity_plan.md policies/vendor_management_policy.md policies/incident_response_plan.md policies/cryptography_policy.md | cut -c1-160; echo ====; head -c 900 reports/okta_mfa_report.json; echo; echo ====; head -c 900 reports/jamf_mdm_c
